messages:
sam: Morning — saw ~30 pages last night from gpu_node_util > 90% in us-west-2 during an autoscaler churn window. Most were 1–2m spikes when nodes terminated.

maria: yep, got alerts too. Root cause: node replacement + k8s pod reschedules. Paging threshold at 90% p99 is too sensitive for short spikes.

jon: proposal: change alert to require 'for: 8m' (sustained), group by nodepool and gpu_type, and add an inhibition when label autoscaler_activity="true".

tess: also add 'replace_with_ticket' routing for non-sustained events, i.e., create ticket for 5–10m aggregated incidents but only page when sustained >15m or error budget breach.

maria: sample Prometheus rule:

```yaml
- alert: GPU_Node_SustainedHighUtil
  expr: avg_over_time(node_gpu_utilization[10m]) > 0.85
  for: 8m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU sustained high util on {{ $labels.nodepool }}"
```

sam: +1, but we need grouping key to avoid paging every node. use labels: nodepool, region, instance_type.

jon: also add mute window in Grafana for scheduled cluster updates (03:00-04:00 UTC) and an auto-snooze when 'k8s_node_terminated_total' increases rapidly.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0412-27 for last night's flurry — tracking.

tess: cost note — we should suppress pages for transient GPU bursts caused by training batch rebalancing; they inflate paging costs and wake SREs unnecessarily.

sam: action items: (1) update prometheus rule with for:8m and grouping labels; (2) add inhibition for autoscaler label; (3) create Grafana muted window for maintenance; (4) add runbook snippet describing when to escalate to page vs ticket.

jon: I'll open a PR to /ops/monitoring with the rule + Grafana panel link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/gpu-cluster-health

maria: assigning to @jon and @tess. I'll follow up with test alerts in staging.

sam: thanks — please post PR link and ETA. :thumbsup:
